title: Toyota Pickup Engines by Year (1964–1995)
description: Every factory engine in the US Toyota compact pickup by year, 1964–1995: the Stout's 3R, the 8R, 18R, 20R and 22R fours, the 3.0 V6, and the L and 2L diesels.
intro: Toyota sold its compact pickup in the US as the Stout from 1964 and the Hi-Lux, later simply the Toyota Truck or Pickup, from 1969 until the Tacoma replaced it for 1995.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.
The first Hi-Lux used the 1.9 8R-C four.
The 20R and, from 1981, the 2.4 22R and a 2.2 diesel.
The 22R, fuel-injected 22R-E and turbocharged 22R-TE, the 2L and 2L-T diesels, and the 3.0 V6 from 1988.
